title: Sindh Local Government Fourth Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Fourth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (FOURTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (FOURTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXI of 2002
An Ordinance to
further amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 28th June, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(21)/2002,
dated 28-6-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local Government
(Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Fourth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 111 of Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (FOURTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (FOURTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXI of 2002
An Ordinance to
further amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 28th June, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(21)/2002,
dated 28-6-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 111 of
Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.---In the Sindh Local Government
Ordinance, 2001, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 111,
in subsection (4), between the word "departmentally" and the word
"as" the words and comma ", except utilities", shall be
inserted.
